scope: Independent read-only artifact audit; no pair-distance full scan, geometry recomputation, optimizer, DeepSeekHarness, experiments, or background polling was run. This file is newly created; original experiment artifacts were not modified.
count_interpretation: 74 PASS rows include 8 known-defective original G1 runs and 8 corrected G1 runs; they are not 74 independent valid algorithm comparisons. Original 45 planned new configurations plus 8 boundary-fix runs + 5 expanded neutrality configurations + 6 P5 repeats + 10 E runs = 74 listed completed run artifacts. 36 references are not new experiments.

run_audit_summary.manifest_mismatch_explanation: Six P5 runs record an earlier manifest hash; the narrowed manifest and old-hash list are documented in manifest/round_p5_override_record.json.

snapshot_interpretation: Top-level code_snapshot.json still describes the pre-boundary-fix source/tests. Corrected run code_version.json records updated path_window source hashes. The full 803/4 frozen suite log does not by itself establish a post-fix full-suite result.

findings.finding: Report says A loses under every tested cap. BASE wins 11/12 matched capped cells, while A wins R/challenge/cap60: 15408 vs 16285, with 59.77012005618599 vs 37.755475383019075 mm stage delta.
findings.impact: Invalidates universal rejection of A under length constraints; does not change BASE superiority in all six main-start capped cells.

findings.finding: E main R2880=15935 is compared to BASE=18444 in report; 18444 belongs to main N2880. Correct R control is 19233, actual evaluations both 2880, same fixed main start. E remains better by 3298 pairs; stage delta rises 53.625801242131274 -> 80.29249451839132 mm, transitions 356 -> 418.
findings.impact: Changes improvement magnitude and comparator identity, not the main R geometric ranking.

findings.finding: With E generation unchanged, target limit 200 -> 2000 enables main runs to use 720/1440/2880 actual evaluations, yielding 31785/23894/15935 pairs. Old E main run stops at 668 evaluations and 32565 pairs. The first 200 core steps of the R2880 traces are identical.
findings.impact: Supports an early stopping explanation for old low-budget utilization; does not establish E optical benefit or eliminate generation/cache inefficiency.

findings.classification: 存在问题/尚未排除解释
findings.finding: Zero-candidate cache lookup derives points through dynamic_anchors without witness_anchor; cache write uses points after multi_anchor witness augmentation. This mismatch can prevent a structural zero-candidate cache hit. E main R2880 T2000 shows 1933 target attempts, 1743 zero-candidate steps, zero generation_skip_events, and repeated empty target pairs.
findings.impact: Undermines attributing E prior underperformance solely to an arbitrary target cap. It is an efficiency/counter interaction; current saved E geometric endpoint is still real. A corrected-key execution has not been measured.

findings.finding: Corrected G1 beats G0 in 7/8 cells under the same evaluation-budget ceiling and lowers total stage length in 8/8. Six main cells use equal actual evaluation counts; challenge N uses 2353 vs 2489 and challenge R 2481 vs 2489, both stop at target limit 200.
findings.impact: 7/8 is same-ceiling evidence, not eight equal-actual-evaluation comparisons or eight independent cases; N/R low-budget trajectories coincide. G1 main R2880 adds logical transitions (356 -> 408) while reducing stage length (53.6258 -> 30.0969 mm), so no net optical-loss ranking follows.

findings.finding: Report section 9 still states 94 total/64 PASS/30 reference; current verification is 110/74/36. The current active artifact census is complete, but prose count omits E extra queue.
findings.impact: Reporting/provenance clarity, no endpoint ranking change.
